**Checklist**

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] Golden views: I ran `make golden` only when the view had to change, and I reviewed each diff.
- [ ] Docs are up to date (README, `docs/`, GLOSSARY.md).
- [ ] Fixtures and tests use fake data only: no real hosts, IP addresses, user names, or key paths.
- [ ] The change does not weaken the safe-write flow or the consent gate (docs/safety.md).
